explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The theorem says that restriction multiplies the layer invariant on degree-2 cohomology by the relative degree. That is the usual compatibility of the local invariant map with restriction in local class field theory. It is stated entirely in terms of the library's own definitions (`layerInv`, `NormalLayer`, `LayerRestriction`, `cohomologyRes`, `unitsFormation`, `relativeDegree`). Mathlib does not define Brauer-group invariants of nonarchimedean local fields, so it cannot contain this compatibility statement. I did not search Mathlib's sources for this check. The proof only rewrites with library lemmas (`layerInv_apply`, `explicitInfl2_cohomologyRes`, `subgroupInvMap_explicitMap2_subgroupInclusion`, `relativeDegree_def`), and none of them is a Mathlib declaration.
